_comment: Our gesture classes, recorded with record_session.py. Numbered 1-5 with no-action = 5 so the existing pipeline is unchanged: training label = id - 1 (5 outputs), board config.yaml outputs.channels = 5, live_gesture_bridge.py treats output 4 as 'no gesture'. NOTE: ids 1-4 here are NOT the organisers' dataset classes (their 01-04 = sit/lay-down/hello/dance) - when dataset clips are mixed in (e.g. as no-action negatives) they must be renamed. 'how' is shown on screen while recording; 'go2' is the robot action. Event camera: every gesture must be a REPEATED movement (still poses are invisible) with big arm motions (the model sees ~40x40 px). Left/right = the PERSON's own left/right. 'mirror' pairs: a horizontal-flip augmentation must swap these labels.

classes.name: heart
classes.how: both hands meet on top of your head (arms make a heart), open the arms out to the sides, back up, repeat

classes.name: turn-left-360
classes.how: STRETCH YOUR LEFT arm straight out to your left side at shoulder height, bring it back to your chest, repeat (keep moving - a held arm is invisible)

classes.name: turn-right-360
classes.how: STRETCH YOUR RIGHT arm straight out to your right side at shoulder height, bring it back to your chest, repeat (keep moving - a held arm is invisible)

classes.name: namaskaram
classes.how: palms together in front of your chest, bow forward from the waist and come back up, repeat
classes.note: dropped for now (2026-11-21): too faint for the event camera; id kept so outputs stay 5

classes.name: no-action
classes.how: move naturally: talk with your hands, scratch your head, shift your weight - but NONE of the gestures
